  • Uses of EgradxAuthResult in com.egradx.auth

    Methods in com.egradx.auth that return EgradxAuthResult
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    EgradxAuthResult
    EgradxAuthService.issueSession(UUID userId, UUID organizationId)
    A new session for someone already proved to be who they are — by an invitation just accepted, a password just changed, or a session in another organization: an access token and a refresh token scoped to organizationId.
    EgradxAuthResult
    EgradxAuthService.login(EgradxLoginRequest request)
    Verifies credentials, resolves which organization the resulting session is scoped to, and issues an access + refresh token pair.
    EgradxAuthResult
    EgradxAuthService.refreshAccessToken(EgradxRefreshTokenRequest request)
    Continues the session a refresh token belongs to: a new access token, and a new refresh token in place of the one presented, which is retired (rotation).
    EgradxAuthResult
    EgradxAuthService.signInVerified(UUID userId, UUID requestedOrganizationId, String method, String provider)
    Signs in someone already proved to be who they are by another method than a password — an emailed code, or an OpenID Connect provider — choosing the organization as a password sign-in does, and recording auth.login with method (and provider, if given).
    EgradxAuthResult
    EgradxAuthService.switchOrganization(UUID userId, UUID organizationId, String currentRefreshToken)
    Moves the person's session into another organization they belong to: a new access token and a new refresh token, scoped there.
